title: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 Game's Trailer Previews Story, New Characters, West City
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming on Tuesday a new trailer for Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 , the third game in the Dragon Ball Xenoverse series. The video, titled "Welcome to West City Trailer," introduces original characters Brett, Lilica, ROM, and Tap.
author: ANN

title: The Ribbon Hero Anime Film's 2nd Trailer Unveils More Cast, Theme Song
content: Anime studio Twin Engine posted the second trailer for The Ribbon Hero , its new anime film based on Osamu Tezuka 's Princess Knight ( Ribbon no Kishi ) manga, on Tuesday. The trailer announces more cast members, and it also announces and previews the theme song "Reborn" by the Japanese/Korean group Girls Archives.
author: ANN

title: THE RIBBON HERO Reveals New Trailer, Theme Song by Girls Archives, Additional Voice Cast
content: THE RIBBON HERO , the new film based on Osamu Tezuka’s Ribbon no Kishi ( Princess Knight ) has revealed a new trailer, theme song and additional voice cast. This is the franchise’s first anime project in 27 years , and it will premiere globally exclusively on Netflix on August 8, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko' Reveals Main Staff, 2027 Debut
content: Production company Asmik Ace opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's Fuun kara no Saikyou Otoko ( The Strongest Man, Born from Misfortune ) light novel on Tuesday, revealing the main staff, the image song, and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Yuki Kodama's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori Manga Gets Live-Action Series
content: NHK announced on Tuesday that it is producing a live-action series of Yuki Kodama 's Ao no Hana Utsuwa no Mori (Blue Flower, Forest of Vessels) manga that will premiere on NHK 's "Yorudora" programming block this fall.
author: ANN

title: 'The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune' Anime Reveals Teaser Image, 2027 Debut, Staff
content: The staff of the anime adaptation of Fukufuku 's The Strongest Man, Born From Misfortune ( Fuun kara no Saikyō Otoko ) light novel series revealed a teaser image, four staff members, and 2027 debut on Tuesday.
